scope: Facet-query plans after a fresh isolated PostgreSQL database, migrations and transactional seed import. No ANALYZE maintenance command was run. EXPLAIN ANALYZE timings describe local SQL execution, not whole HTTP requests or CI latency.

reported_ci_failure.symptom: 15-second statement timeout in ingredient facets on x86 CI
reported_ci_failure.local_reproduction_limit: The timeout and a JIT compilation event were not reproduced in this fresh local sample. Query expansion and join fan-out are established; JIT as the CI amplifier remains unconfirmed by this local profile.

change.candidate_rows: One canonical product per row. Ingredient text, same-bottling strength and selected group predicates use EXISTS.
change.coverage: Zero is the nonnegative score default and adds no coverage predicate. Positive thresholds still evaluate the six documentation areas.
change.facets: Facets precede selected ingredient-group filtering and count distinct products. Candidate IDs remain in SQL.
change.result_cards: Coverage annotations and bounded photograph/detail prefetches are attached to the final page.

new_regressions: Ingredient-name search with lower and upper strength on the same bottling
Facet counts before group selection, one count per product despite repeated recipe inputs
Positive documentation threshold affects candidates and facets
validation.initial_failure_and_resolution: The first focused run exposed duplicate approved-front prefetches when annotation was repeated for a positive coverage or photograph filter. Pure coverage annotations were separated from final-card prefetches; all ten focused tests then passed.

root_reported_full_fresh_docker_suite.scope: Root-reported full fresh Docker PostgreSQL validation after the discovery fix.

live_http_interpretation: Three local uncached HTTP requests with expected result totals. These are individual latency observations, not a throughput benchmark or a guarantee of other environments.
status: Native GitHub CI passed all three jobs for the uncorrelated set-query application. Historical local/emulated failures remain preserved; a unique low-level cause was not established.

subsequent_ci_failure.symptom: 15-second PostgreSQL timeout in candidate count for ingredient search plus a selected group.
subsequent_ci_failure.interpretation: The first rewrite passed the recorded local tests and measurements but still failed on CI. A second uncorrelated SQL ID-set rewrite is under separate x86 validation; the historical numbers below must not be presented as proof that the CI issue is resolved.

second_rewrite.implementation: Uncorrelated SQL ID sets: UNION ALL of independent product-name, brand-name and ingredient matches; IN for both strength bounds on one bottling and IN for selected ingredient groups. No client-side ID materialization.

x86_sql_probe.platform: isolated PostgreSQL 17 x86_64 container; ARM application client

Plans.Join Filter: ((upper((catalog_product.name)::text) ~~ '%QA FACET NEEDLE%'::text) OR (upper((catalog_brand.name)::text) ~~ '%QA FACET NEEDLE%'::text) OR (ANY (catalog_product.id = (hashed SubPlan 2).col1)))

x86_sql_probe.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
x86_sql_probe.interpretation: SQL timings only, one local x86-emulated database sample. Both old and new queries completed here; the remote CI timeout and a JIT cause were not reproduced. The set-query rewrite removes correlated search/group subplans without changing the 15-second deadline. Remote CI remains required.

full_x86_suite.interpretation: Full isolated x86 suite reproduced five discovery facet timeouts, despite passing individual SQL probes. This candidate was not published; instrumented diagnosis follows.

uninstrumented_x86_cli.process_cleanup: A diagnostic watcher retained a test-database session during teardown. A clean repeat without that watcher is required. This is not an application test failure.
uninstrumented_x86_cli.interpretation: The actual Django CLI executed all tests without a query wrapper. Earlier five emulated-x86 failures are retained above; no definitive JIT or other platform-specific cause is claimed.

clean_x86_cli.instrumentation: None. Actual manage.py test catalog --noinput, no watcher, query wrapper or custom runner.

second_rewrite.live_http_scope: Three individual uncached localhost HTTP requests, not a throughput benchmark.
